description: Route each procedure to the shard that owns its account.
rationale: Without delegation every CALL is a distributed transaction from the coordinator; with it, a single-account procedure runs entirely on one worker. That difference is a large part of what these variants exist to measure.

intents.name: account_transfer
intents.comment: Routed to the shard owning account_from.

intents.name: account_deposit
intents.comment: Routed to the shard owning deposit_account.

intents.name: account_withdrawal
intents.comment: Routed to the shard owning withdrawal_account.
